newsitem.title: USA: Prevent Products says FDA clears pump.
newsitem.headline: Prevent Products says FDA clears pump.

text.p: Prevent Products Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration found the company's Phlebopump to be substantially equivalent to devices marketed prior to 1976 and cleared it for marketing.
The determination was made pursuant to Section 510(k) of the Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act, the company said.
The Phlebopump can be used for cardiovascular purposes.
Prevent Products develops and sells rehabilitative and protective products to nursing home residents, as well as other medical products.
